name: VLR-Bench
description: VLR-Bench is a multilingual visual question answering benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language models based on retrieval augmented generation (RAG). It includes multiple input passages to test the model's ability to identify relevant information for answering queries, addressing a gap in existing external knowledge-based VQA datasets.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the VQA/RAG literature, with limited but growing attention as a specialized test for multilingual retrieval-augmented vision-language models.
notes: Includes 5 input passages per query to test retrieval augmented generation capabilities; dataset is automatically generated instruction-following examples.
